Container.Name: Alarm-HUB
Container.Overview: Alarm-HUB is a standalone multi-user alarm service with manual alarms, mobile API access, optional WebComm Calendar Sync integration, direct WebComm import, and optional commute-aware alarms. PostgreSQL is embedded by default, so a normal Unraid installation requires only one container. Persistent application and database data are stored below /config.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: alarm alarms wecker webcomm schedule shortcut ios automation commute routing
Container.Requires: No separate PostgreSQL container is required for the default embedded database mode. For public Internet access, use a reverse proxy with a valid HTTPS certificate and enable secure session cookies. Commute routing is optional; OpenRouteService is used for address lookup plus Auto/Fahrrad routing, while Bus/Bahn uses the free open-source Transitous service.
Container.Changes: Added optional commute-aware WebComm alarms. Auto and bicycle routing use OpenRouteService; Bus/Bahn uses the free open-source Transitous service with target arrival at shift start.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Alarm-HUB WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Alarm-HUB data, including the embedded PostgreSQL database and generated application secret.

Config.Name: Database Mode
Config.Description: embedded = integrated PostgreSQL database (recommended); external = use your own PostgreSQL server.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional in embedded mode: when left empty Alarm-HUB creates and persists a strong secret under /config. Set and keep a fixed value for external/managed deployments if desired.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookies
Config.Description: Default false for direct local HTTP access in Unraid. Set true when Alarm-HUB is published through an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: OpenRouteService API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Required for commute routing because Alarm-HUB uses OpenRouteService for address lookup and for Auto/Fahrrad routes. Bus/Bahn itself is routed through Transitous and needs no extra API key.
